title: bug: get_activity_log's eventTypes schema example advertises TASK_STATUS_CHANGED, a type that is not in ACTIVITY_EVENT_TYPES and is never emitted, and any unknown eventTypes value silently matches nothing, so a seat following the example gets 0 events with no hint
description:
Held item from hunt #11 (task-afe61cc0, architect-74d9e1c7, msg-7ed73235), filed by the governor. Re-checked at tip 8ca8d389: getActivityLog.ts is unchanged since the repro HEAD 31492ac5.

PROBLEM. The tool's input schema tells callers to filter with `eventTypes` "(e.g. STEP_COMPLETED, TASK_STATUS_CHANGED)". TASK_STATUS_CHANGED does not exist. ACTIVITY_EVENT_TYPES (types/schema.ts:1710) has TASK_UPDATED, TASK_STARTED, TASK_COMPLETED, TASK_REOPENED, TASK_BLOCKED and so on, and no emitter writes the advertised type. An unknown eventTypes value silently matches nothing, so the documented example returns an empty page that looks like "no status changes".

EVIDENCE:
- getActivityLog.ts:192 (at 8ca8d389): `description: 'Filter by event types (e.g. STEP_COMPLETED, TASK_STATUS_CHANGED)'`.
- Repro: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-afe61cc0/B/zzHuntB_eventTypeExample.test.ts with its .output.txt. "a status change is findable with the advertised TASK_STATUS_CHANGED filter, or the filter is refused" fails, "Tests 1 failed (1)".

FIX DIRECTION.
- Correct the example to name emitted types.
- Report unknown eventTypes values additively, for example an `unknownEventTypes` list or a warning in the response. Don't refuse them: MCP contract changes stay additive.
- Keep the response shape otherwise unchanged.

PLACEMENT. Open row task-05a77c0d (activity-log rotation) edits src/state/activityLog.ts, reverseReader.ts and a new rotation test, not tools/getActivityLog.ts. So this row edits getActivityLog.ts plus its own test, and no dependsOn is needed. Leave docs/MCP_SERVER.md alone unless lanes.js shows it free.
definitionOfDone: get_activity_log's eventTypes schema text names only types in ACTIVITY_EVENT_TYPES, and a test pins that every example type in the description is a member.

A query whose eventTypes include an unknown value still returns its normal page, and the response also reports the unknown value(s) additively. The ported hunt repro passes, and the existing get_activity_log tests stay green in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.

implementationPlan.description:
GREEN: edit packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/getActivityLog.ts with the Edit tool only. The architect's dry-run diff (+10/-1) is /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-72f02ef3/getActivityLog.diff.

(a) Imports: keep `import type { ActivityEvent } ...` and add `import { ACTIVITY_EVENT_TYPES } from '../types/schema.js';`. StateManager.ts and activityLog.ts already import that value, so there is no cycle risk.

(b) After ACTIVITY_LOG_FILTER_SCAN_LIMIT, add `const KNOWN_EVENT_TYPES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(ACTIVITY_EVENT_TYPES);` with a 2-line comment. The comment says these are the only types a query can return: the log reader skips any line whose event is not one of them (state/activityLog.ts:171), so no other value can match.

(c) queryActivityLog, right after the eventTypes filter block (:134-137):
- add `const unknownEventTypes = [...new Set(params.eventTypes ?? [])].filter(t => !KNOWN_EVENT_TYPES.has(t));` with a 2-line comment: reported, never refused (additive contract), so an empty page does not read as "no such events";
- in the returned object, right after `hasMore,`, add `...(unknownEventTypes.length > 0 ? { unknownEventTypes } : {}),`.
- Leave the eventTypes filter itself unchanged: still exact, case-sensitive matching.

(d) The eventTypes description (:192) becomes exactly 'Filter by event types (e.g. STEP_COMPLETED, TASK_UPDATED, TASK_BLOCKED). A value that is not an activity event type matches nothing and is echoed back in unknownEventTypes.'
- (e1) parses the parenthetical, so keep it a plain comma-separated list of type names.
- TASK_UPDATED is the type a status change set through updateTask is logged under.

Error handling: no new throw and no new catch.
- normalizeActivityLogParams's eventTypes validation stays as it is: an array, at most 50 items, non-empty strings, otherwise invalidInput.
- An unknown value is reported, never refused, so callers that pass one today get the same page plus one additive key.
- The /ws GET_ACTIVITY_LOG path takes only `events` from queryActivityLog (WebSocketServer.ts:443), so the IDE reply is unchanged.

Scope:
- Do NOT edit docs/MCP_SERVER.md: task-34e42a0a (REVIEW) and task-c8d6dbd5 (WORKING) both hold it. Documenting unknownEventTypes in the get_activity_log section is the governor's follow-up.
- Do NOT touch backfillTaskMetrics.ts:63-69. It has its own dead TASK_STATUS_CHANGED comparison, which is out of scope.
